snippet.title: Old Friend - Indie Horror Game - All Endings (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
You get a call from an old friend. They ask for a favor, but something feels wrong. What starts as a normal night turns into a fight for your life. Can you escape the danger and uncover the truth?

Play It Here: https://keeragames.itch.io/old-friend
